Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

In this petition, the petitioner seeks the following reliefs:
"a) Call for the entire record in Crime No.82/2024 pending on the file of Hon'ble JMFC 2nd Court, Mangalore City, Mangalore for the offences punishable under sections 498A, 506, 406, 420 of IPC.

b) Quash the FIR and Complaint in Crime No. 82/2024 for the offences punishable under sections 498A, 506, 406, 420 of IPC, now pending on the file of Hon'ble JMFC 2nd Court, Mangalore City, Mangalore instituted by the Respondent No.1/Surathkal PS.
c) Pass such other relief/reliefs as this Hon'ble court deems fit in the facts and circumstance of the present case in the interest of justice and equity."
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Additional SPP for the respondent-State and perused the material on record.
In light of charge sheet having been submitted by the respondent police on 12.11.2024 even prior to filing of the present petition, nothing further survives for consideration in the present petition.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to file fresh petition seeking appropriate reliefs.

Sd/-
